envelope.cause: regrounding with the operator, 2026-09-29: shards state what and why, never how; the design is the fixed goal

payload.gloss: the position an agent holds is what its host routes a model by. Each agent carries to the harness the role it holds, never a model; the host decides which model fills each role. Where the host has decided nothing, the agent runs on the harness's ordinary default, or, on a harness that routes only by tier, on the tier suited to the position's work: spec-bounded building on the middle tier, holding and judging design on the top tier. Install makes the roles visible to the host as something it can set, and never changes a choice the host has made.
